visual_connections.description: Developer pushes code to Git repository.
Git webhooks notify Lagoon EKS of repo events.
Lagoon triggers deployment to the target hosting EKS cluster across the boundary.
EKS cluster utilizes EC2 on-demand instances.
EKS cluster utilizes EC2 Spot instances for non-production workloads.
EC2 instances connect to Aurora R6g database.
EC2 Spot workloads provision and attach EBS gp3 storage volumes.
EC2 Spot workloads connect to EFS file system storage.
